title: Cosmic Racer
description: Race through the cosmos avoiding obstacles and collecting star power in this intense reflex-based arcade game.
instructions: Use Left/Right arrows or tap sides of screen to steer. Collect stars for speed boosts.

title: Neon Puzzle Block
description: Drag and drop glowing blocks to form complete lines. A modern twist on the classic block-clearing game with retrowave aesthetics.
instructions: Drag shapes onto the grid. Fill horizontal or vertical lines to clear them. Game ends when no more shapes fit.

title: Zombie Defense Squad
description: Hold the line against waves of zombies. Upgrade your weapons, hire mercenaries, and survive as long as possible.
instructions: Aim with mouse, click to shoot. Use number keys to switch weapons or abilities.

title: Pixel Adventurer
description: Explore ancient ruins, jump over spike pits, and defeat monsters to find the lost artefact in this retro platformer.
instructions: Arrows/WASD to move and jump. Spacebar to attack.

title: Hyper Dunk 2024
description: Fast-paced street basketball action. Perform crazy dunks and outscore your opponents before the timer runs out.
instructions: Arrow keys to move, Spacebar to shoot or jump when near the hoop.

title: Tower Defense Clash
description: Strategically place your towers to defend the kingdom from invading hordes of orcs and goblins.
instructions: Click to select a tower, click on an empty slot to build. Upgrade towers to increase range and damage.

title: Tank Battles.io
description: Multiplayer tank warfare. Destroy polygons to level up, upgrade your tank, and dominate the leaderboard by destroying other players.
instructions: WASD to move, Mouse to aim and click to shoot.

title: Classic Brick Breaker
description: The timeless arcade classic. Bounce the ball and break all the bricks to advance to the next level. Catch power-ups for advantages.
instructions: Move the mouse to control the paddle. Do not let the ball fall down.

title: Drift King Pro
description: Master the art of drifting on challenging mountain tracks. Earn points for speed and angle combos.
instructions: Use WASD or Arrows to drive. Press Space to use handbrake.

title: Sudoku Master
description: Train your brain with daily Sudoku puzzles. Clean UI, note-taking features, and varying difficulties.
instructions: Click on a cell and select a number from 1 to 9. Fill the grid so every row, column, and 3x3 box contains all digits.

title: Sniper Contract
description: Take on high-stakes missions as an elite sniper. Account for wind and distance for the perfect shot.
instructions: Move mouse to aim, scroll to zoom, click to fire.

title: Escape The Dungeon
description: A point-and-click adventure where you must solve puzzles and find hidden objects to escape a mysterious castle dungeon.
instructions: Click to interact with objects, collect items, and use them to progress.

title: Penalty Shootout: World Cup
description: Lead your country to glory in this tense penalty shootout simulator. Play as both the striker and the goalkeeper.
instructions: Swipe or drag to determine direction, height, and power of the shot/save.

title: Chess AI Grandmaster
description: Play chess against a powerful AI or a friend locally. Features game analysis and beautiful 3D boards.
instructions: Drag and drop pieces according to standard chess rules.

title: Snake Multiplayer
description: The classic snake game but with a twist - you are competing against other players on the same map. Don't hit their tails!
instructions: Arrow keys to control the snake. Eat dots to grow.

title: Fruit Slicer Ninja
description: Slice as many fruits as you can while avoiding the bombs. A great reflex trainer.
instructions: Click and drag to slice. Don't slice bombs!

title: Moto X3M Spooky Land
description: Ride your dirt bike through horrifyingly awesome Halloween-themed obstacle courses.
instructions: Up/Down arrows to accelerate/brake. Left/Right to tilt and flip.

title: Mahjong Solitaire
description: A relaxing tile-matching game. Clear the board by finding matching pairs of free tiles.
instructions: Click two matching tiles to remove them. A tile must be free on at least one side to be selectable.

title: Alien Invaders
description: Protect Earth from descending waves of alien spacecraft in this faithful recreation of the 80s classic.
instructions: Left/Right arrow to move ship. Space to shoot lasers.

title: Mini Golf Club
description: Play through creative mini-golf courses. Physics-based gameplay with challenging obstacles.
instructions: Click and drag back from the ball to set power and angle, then release to putt.
